rationale: All three lenses ran on the production diff (785 lines); tests/live harness code, evidence JSON and test files (about 4,000 lines) were not line-reviewed, so coverage is partial. One real defect was found and already fixed in the working tree (lost backslash in the local-command regex). One finding is a probable double count (compaction events of a continuation), and two need an owner decision (reopened session that works but never gets a Stop; missing started_at clamp from the plan). Deferred: 7 (hook-path sibling scan cost, lock-free state read fails open, unbounded hold while OTel heartbeats continue, per-tick parse-state read cost, 15 s delay of late flushes for ordinary ended sessions, Stop/SessionEnd/git snapshot still forwarded for an empty continuation, idle-pass lifecycle events not re-derivable); dismissed: 3 (unverified or already covered by accepted decisions D-2/D-7/D-9).

findings.title: Local-command regex has a literal 's*' instead of '\s*'
findings.problem: isLocalCommandTurn used /^s*<(command-name|...)/; the backslash was lost, so a local-command line whose text starts with whitespace or a newline is treated as a genuine prompt.
findings.impact: A continuation or reopen whose only activity is such a line is counted as own work: the continuation summary is sent and a reopen flips to active, releasing held OTel records, which reintroduces the 16992/16993 symptoms.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in the working tree (/^\s*<...). Add a unit test with leading whitespace/newline text and re-run the affected tests.

findings.title: Compaction scan is not continuation-aware
findings.problem: scanCompactions/isCompactionNewer read every compact_boundary in the child transcript, including copies from the parent, and report all of them as the child's compaction.done events when lastCompactionEnd is empty. Reported by the edge-case lens from reading the code; not reproduced.
findings.impact: A continued session re-reports the parent's compactions, the same double count 16992 is about, for compaction events.
findings.recommendation: Skip compact_boundary lines whose uuid is in the inherited set (or older than the first own line) in the scan; add a continuation test with a copied compact_boundary.

findings.title: Reopened session that works but never gets a Stop loses its OTel records
findings.problem: reopenActive is set only by a hook pass that reads transcript lines. If the user reopens, works, and the terminal is killed before any Stop/SessionEnd, the daemon still sees an idle reopen and drops the held records unsent after the 60 min abandoned grace (idle_reopen_expired). D-9 covers only a reopen that stayed idle.
findings.impact: Real usage telemetry of that session is lost. A long first turn after a reopen is also withheld until its first Stop.
findings.recommendation: Choose: (a) accept and document, (b) have the hold also check the transcript file for own activity lines before dropping or releasing, or (c) release on the first non-startup native record (api_request, tool_result, user_prompt with text) as the original plan's record-level split intended.

findings.title: Plan step to clamp a continuation's started_at to sessionStartedAt is not implemented
findings.problem: Task 3 of the plan clamps started_at to state.sessionStartedAt as a safety net; the implementation relies only on positional ownership. A copied line that has a uuid but was not in the parent's counted set ends the skip phase early and later uuid-less copies can still set the start.
findings.impact: Started could still show the parent's time in that edge case. Live scenarios S3/S4 pass without the clamp.
findings.recommendation: Choose: add the clamp (small, matches the plan) or record in accepted-decisions that positional ownership replaces it and why.
